keep_now: AI suggested reply with agent-controlled send
post_v1_only: predictive intelligence beyond evidence-backed bounded signals
cr_v1_boundary.rule: This admission preparation must not expand frozen CR-V1 Customer Context + Agent Assist scope.

not_a_claim: not a full CRM/CDP build authorization

shopify.capability: Dynamic rule-based customer segments, broad customer filters, RFM analysis and predicted-spend tiers are native platform capabilities; customer profiles expose purchase-history context.

ikas.capability: Dynamic customer segments can be built from behavioral/property criteria and used for targeted marketing; customer groups and marketing-consent/account-state filters are available.

ticimax.capability: Ticimax markets customer segmentation and personalized campaign automation based on customer characteristics/behavior. Exact customer intelligence API/schema behavior is not admitted by this marketing-level evidence.

ideasoft.capability: Member/dealer groups support group-specific pricing, campaigns and discounts; IdeaSoft Email states customer/product CRM integration plus segmentation and dynamic content. This does not establish advanced predictive Customer 360 as first-party platform capability.

tsoft.capability: T-Soft supports member segmentation with up to 100 segments and web-service creation/member association, plus member groups for differentiated pricing/content. Partner integrations also advertise unified profiles/real-time behavioral targeting; partner capability is not relabeled first-party core.

woocommerce.capability: WooCommerce Analytics Customers Report exposes registered/guest customer purchase context and filters such as order count, total spend, AOV, registration and last active; broader CRM/CDP behavior is extension-dependent and not assumed.

commoditized_or_utility: generic CRM-like notes/tags if already supplied by platform/helpdesk
candidate_durable_core: provider-independent CustomerIdentity resolution with source/evidence lineage
verified customer-to-order access and deterministic disclosure authorization
cross-channel Customer Context assembled from capability-gated commerce/support sources
explicit freshness/conflict/UNKNOWN handling for customer facts
consent/suppression/channel eligibility as authority, not model inference
merchant-defined rules and purpose-scoped use of customer context
derived customer signals with feature/source/version/explanation and confidence boundaries
segment portability layer that can consume provider-native segments without making them universal truth
Agency Managed multi-client isolation and exception-oriented customer operations
evaluation/outcome lineage connecting recommendation/action to correction, handoff and business result

derived_signal_requirements: no deterministic factual claim from a probabilistic score

open_evidence: target-provider E3 customer/order identity and disclosure fields
exact consent/marketing-permission semantics and revocation behavior by provider/channel
real merchant need for cross-platform Customer Context beyond native profiles
predictive/derived signal accuracy, calibration, drift and business outcome evidence
privacy/retention/purpose-limitation review for advanced Customer Intelligence
willingness-to-pay and support burden versus platform-native segmentation/CRM tooling
phase_entry_recommendation: KEEP CR-V1 Customer Context + Agent Assist unchanged. For Post-V1 Phase 2C, do not build a full CRM/CDP or generic segmentation engine. Productize only the provider-independent identity/context/disclosure/consent/evidence/evaluation layer that remains valuable across platforms; integrate native segmentation/prediction primitives where adequate and evidence-addressable.
